lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines are visible; spacing is relatively dense and consistent through the mid-torso but becomes significantly wider in the posterior region between lines 9, 10, and 11.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal termination of the 7th line from the shoulder, where it splits/merges with the 8th line segment near the dorsal crest.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 2nd line from the anterior is abbreviated and terminates mid-torso; the 11th line is fragmented into two distinct vertical segments that do not meet.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A discrete cluster of 2 high-contrast white spots is located on the lateral posterior haunch, positioned superiorly to the white popliteal hair patch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated pixel ratio of 3.4:1 between the terminal horn tips and the width of the proximal horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.12 of the total horn length consists of high-contrast ivory/yellow-white tipping at the distal ends.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the lower cheek/malar region; white chevron marking between the orbital regions; prominent dark ventral fringe extending from the throat to the lower abdomen.
